subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the longest night of winter's deepest cold.
source_quote: On the longest night of winter's deepest cold, the keeper falls, the heart is sold.

subject: elapsed time
fact: Forty-one years pass in the corner of the library where Vareth has kept his office.
source_quote: He has been keeping this corner of the library for forty-one years, he says

subject: chasme count
fact: Three duels have been fought at Candlekeep over which polemic shelf gets the larger window.
source_quote: Three duels have been fought at Candlekeep over which polemic shelf gets the larger window. *Three*, in a library where nobody has dueled in two hundred years.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: The Keeper of Tomes is dead, and the First Reader summons the party through the emerald door before the Avowed awake.
source_quote: The Keeper of Tomes is dead! She wants you! Now, through the emerald door, before the avowed awake!

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: The Refectory ceiling is high enough that a hill giant could sit comfortably at one end and not embarrass herself.
source_quote: The Refectory was built for scholars, which meant the ceiling was high enough that a hill giant could have sat comfortably at one end and not embarrassed herself.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The theological document from Asha Vandree's chain mail — the Lolth/Zuggtmoy equivalence — was written in a hand that wanted very much to seem incidental.
source_quote: The theological document from Asha Vandree's chain mail — the Lolth/Zuggtmoy equivalence, written in a hand that wanted very much to seem incidental.

subject: Grygum school of thought
fact: A fourth school of theological thought has been proposed — one centered on fixed points around which actions must revolve, with constrained freedom between them.
source_quote: What if there are certain fixed points around which our actions must revolve? And the closer we come to one of those fixed points, the more constrained we are, but between them, perhaps we have a great deal of freedom of action.

subject: Grygum school of thought
fact: The Grygum school of thought was accidentally proposed and is now being treated by Vareth as the question of the age.
source_quote: I just proposed a school of theological thought by accident, and that an aging scholar with forty-one years in this corner of the library is now treating it as the question of the age.

subject: Candlekeep prophecy inventory
fact: The prophecies of Alaundo are recited daily; fulfilled ones are removed, leaving only the unfulfilled inventory.
source_quote: Whenever one came true, it was removed. What remained was the unfulfilled inventory.

subject: Glabbagool's confinement
fact: Glabbagool the grey ooze, confined in a bag of holding, has reached a breaking point and demands to be let out.
source_quote: Whatever Glabbagool had been doing in the bag all day — thinking, absorbing, trying to formalize whatever Zalthir had been patiently teaching him into monastic discipline — he was done with it. He wanted out.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the day after the Underdark, when rest was a luxury good and rarely in stock.
source_quote: the kind that had felt almost suspicious after the Underdark, where a full night's sleep had been a luxury good and rarely in stock

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: The window was narrowing with every minute we spent in this room

subject: glabbagool count
fact: Glabbagool, with two eyeballs tracking the room, is present in the corner after developing attentiveness since acquiring eyes.
source_quote: Glabbagool had been watching from the corner with the patient attentiveness he'd developed since acquiring eyes... and peered out from the opening with two eyeballs tracking the room

subject: travel to the emerald door
fact: The emerald door is the threshold beyond which danger awaits, and we are not walking into it depleted.
source_quote: Whatever was waiting through the emerald door, we weren't walking into it depleted

subject: Candlekeep grounds elevation
fact: Candlekeep's grounds are blanketed in snow, silent and untouched, after months below stone.
source_quote: Candlekeep's grounds were blanketed in it, white and silent, the kind of silence that had nothing hunting inside it

subject: Astronomicon value
fact: The Astronomicon is a stack of blue globes ascending in scale, containing everything known about the stars.
source_quote: You see that curious blue stack of globes? That's the Astronomicon. Everything we know about the stars can be found there

subject: Whispering Dome value
fact: The Whispering Dome holds voices from the past that linger and can be heard if one stands in the right place.
source_quote: voices from the past lingered there, that you could hear them if you stood in the right place

subject: Drakonoikos elevation
fact: Drakonoikos is a structure built from enormous scales and bones worked into the walls, replacing stone.
source_quote: The structure was built from scales — actual scales, enormous, overlapping — and bones worked into the walls where another building would have used stone

subject: Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber incident
fact: One of the Avowed died in the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber, requiring Keeper's permission for access.
source_quote: One of the Avowed had died in it, he said, which was why the Keeper's permission was now required

subject: Chapter House entrance
fact: The Chapter House has a single guard, single visible point of entry, and no secondary exit apparent from the doorway.
source_quote: single guard, single visible point of entry, no secondary exit apparent from the doorway

subject: Council of Twelve meeting
fact: The Council of Twelve convened in uproar over Janussi's murder, with twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table and a rose window casting colored light.
source_quote: twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table, rose window throwing colored light across the stone floor

subject: Dawnbringer value
fact: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, claims to have been found in a tomb after two thousand years.
source_quote: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, took the opportunity to note that we must surely be the greatest discoverers of all, having found her tomb after two thousand years

subject: library access card value
fact: An all-access library card was requested and granted as part of the investigation agreement, allowing full access to the library.
source_quote: We need an all-access library card... Bookwyrm agreed. One book each, copied at the House of the Binder, upon successful completion. Confidentiality papers first

subject: Crime Scene staircase
fact: The staircase to the crime scene is narrow, requiring single file passage, with Bookwyrm setting the pace.
source_quote: The staircase was narrow enough that we had to go single file, which meant Bookwyrm set the pace

subject: Kalan Strongbranch's arrival
fact: Kalan Strongbranch arrived at the Chapter House after being previously wanted for questioning, and bowed with correct form but suspicious eyes.
source_quote: Kalan Strongbranch walked in... He bowed. The bow was correct and the eyes were not

subject: Janussi's resignation request
fact: Janussi asked Kalan to tender his resignation the morning before his death, citing loss of mental faculties and negligence.
source_quote: yesterday morning, Janussi asked the gate warden to tender his resignation. The Keeper was concerned that Kalan was losing his mental faculties and becoming negligent in his work

subject: Bookwyrm's testimony
fact: Bookwyrm disclosed that Janussi requested Kalan’s resignation, but declined to elaborate, claiming not to prejudice the investigation.
source_quote: Janussi, the morning before his death, had asked Kalan to tender his resignation. Mental faculties. Negligence. She declined to elaborate — she didn't want to prejudice the investigation, she said

subject: Thorin's question to Bookwyrm
fact: Thorin asked Bookwyrm where she was during Janussi’s death, prompting a pause and visible weight in her expression.
source_quote: Thorin, immediate: 'Where were you?' Bookwyrm paused. Not a long pause. Just long enough to weigh something.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: time of death
fact: Janussi was murdered well before half past seven in the morning, as candles burned out and tobacco smoke lingered in a sealed room.
source_quote: Miss Hollypocket would never have allowed the Keeper to let candles burn down to nothing.

subject: gate warden's inspection
fact: The gate warden conducted a full, deliberate inspection of the crime scene at eleven and emerged looking more determined than when he entered.
source_quote: He definitely looked more determined after he walked out.

subject: ink pot and quill
fact: A quill with midnight blue ink and a spilled ink pot were found near the desk, untouched since the spill, suggesting recent annotation before death.
source_quote: A quill on the floor. Nib covered in midnight blue. A wicker basket nearby holding a linen ink carrier, slightly damp.

subject: third floor apartment
fact: The third floor apartment door was left conspicuously ajar, a detail noted but unexamined.
source_quote: a large apartment at the third with its door left conspicuously ajar.

subject: ritual attempt on corpse
fact: The rite to speak with the dead had already been performed by the gate warden, preventing further attempts until sufficient time passed.
source_quote: Someone — presumably the Gate Warden — had already used the rite on the corpse.

subject: cat presence
fact: The gray cat with yellow eyes was observed motionless until approached, then tracked investigators — its nature deemed unprovable as either power or ordinary animal.
source_quote: Nobody had been able to conclusively prove the cat was some kind of power that lived here, and nobody had been able to conclusively prove that it was not.

subject: keeper's chamber tobacco smoke
fact: Lingering tobacco smoke in the sealed keeper’s chamber indicated the room had been closed for hours, suggesting death occurred before discovery.
source_quote: The windows were shut. Nobody had been smoking recently. The smoke was old.

subject: missing heart
fact: Janussi’s heart was removed postmortem, not as cause of death but to prevent resurrection, indicating deliberate magical sabotage.
source_quote: The heart was missing. No other organs. And the blood was localized. Wrong pattern for what should have been a violent death.

subject: book removal
fact: The book 'The Golden Ass' — annotated in fresh midnight blue ink — was missing from the desk, suggesting its contents were intentionally removed.
source_quote: The book the blue ink was annotating — The Golden Ass — wasn't in the room.

subject: safe contents
fact: The safe on the far wall had been opened, blue gems scattered, but left behind — indicating the thief sought something more valuable than jewelry.
source_quote: Blue gems and empty pouches scattered on the floor in front of it. The thief had looked at the gems, decided they weren't what he came for, and left them.

subject: spellbook 'The Discoveries'
fact: An open spellbook titled 'The Discoveries' contained academic notes in Celestial and annotated research in midnight blue and purple ink, suggesting Janussi’s ongoing occult investigations.
source_quote: A spellbook sat open in the center of the desk: The Discoveries. To one side, notes in Celestial... To the other side, a larger pile of notes pinned under a quartz weight, with more annotations on top in midnight blue ink — and below those, older notes in purple.

subject: bookwyrm's arrival
fact: The Bookwyrm arrived at nine, confirmed the gate warden’s orders, and permitted only a brief look before leaving.
source_quote: Bookwyrm at nine, arriving from the baths, allowed a brief look before confirming the existing orders.

subject: fembris's reaction
fact: Fembris vomited after seeing the body, then retreated and did not re-enter, indicating a visceral reaction to the violence.
source_quote: Fembris took one look at the body, crossed the room in four steps, flung a window open, and vomited out of it.

subject: reception chamber
fact: The first landing of the tower contained a reception chamber, noted as the initial point of entry.
source_quote: reception chamber at the first landing

subject: shrine of Oghma
fact: The second landing held a shrine of Oghma, observed during ascent.
source_quote: a shrine of Oghma at the second

subject: tadric's admission
fact: Tadric admitted his role was crowd control, not observation, and realized his failure to monitor internal actions.
source_quote: Tadric admitted his assignment had been crowd control. Not observation.

subject: candelabra
fact: A seven-armed bronze candelabra had burned its candles entirely to wax puddles, supporting the timeline of prolonged seclusion.
source_quote: The candelabra — seven arms, bronze — had burned its candles entirely to wax puddles.

subject: zalthir's observation
fact: Zalthir determined the rib cage was smashed by multiple axe blows, not a single strike, indicating deliberate, forceful violence.
source_quote: the rib cage had been smashed by something like an axe, multiple blows, close together, deliberate.

subject: gate warden's removal
fact: The gate warden was removed from the scene before being questioned, raising suspicion about what he discovered.
source_quote: The gate warden removed before he could be asked what he'd found.

subject: thorin's ice inquiry
fact: Thorin inquired about the availability of ice to preserve the corpse, given the expected decomposition from delay.
source_quote: Corpse will be a little stinky by then. Is there any ice around?
